newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says over 100 rebels killed in battle.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says over 100 rebels killed in battle.

text.p: Sri Lanka said on Saturday that more than 100 Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels were killed when the guerrillas attacked military positions in the northern Wanni region late on Friday.

"One hundred LTTE bodies have been recovered and we believe their dead and wounded should be 200. Four soldiers and 10 policemen were killed and 30 wounded in the attack," a Defence Ministry spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman said clearing operations in the affected area were taking place and more bodies were likely to be recovered.
The rebels attacked the military's defence positions north of the government-held town of Vavuniya, some 220 km (135 miles) north of the capital Colombo, late on Friday but were repulsed.
The military, which launched a major offensive in May, is battling rebels in the Wanni to open a strategic highway linking the northern Jaffna peninsula with the rest of the island.

The LTTE are fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east. The government says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 15th year. The LTTE put the toll higher.
